Submit a New Track

🎵
Drop .mp3 or .wav here — select multiple files for an album or EP
or click to browse
📀 Multiple tracks selected — track titles come from the filenames, and the Album/EP name groups them into one project. Track numbers follow file order. Set who can play each track below.
Uploading…
🖼️
Square image works best (min 500×500). Click the box to choose one, or leave it — we'll grab the art inside your audio file automatically.
Track Review Process
1️⃣
Submit your track
Upload the audio file and fill in metadata. All file formats accepted.
2️⃣
Review (24-48 hrs)
PHX team reviews for audio quality and community guidelines. You'll get a notification either way.
3️⃣
Goes live
Your track appears in the PHX Music catalog immediately on approval. Streams start counting right away.
4️⃣
Get paid — net-60
Earnings for each month finalize 60 days after the month closes (industry-standard fraud & chargeback protection), then pay out automatically. No minimum threshold — every qualifying stream earns.
How You Get Paid
Monthly
net-60 — each month finalizes 60 days after close, no minimum
Your earnings come from the listening of the fans who actually play your music — not a global pool where megastars take everything. The more your fans listen, the more you earn. Every qualifying stream counts.

Per-period history below. During beta (simulation mode) the pot is seeded by founder funding and pays member listening through virtual wallets at each member's locked founding price — same time-weighted, tier-capped, anti-fraud engine as real money. When billing goes live: paying members' unused wallet money flows in, free-tier listening gets paid out, and the beta loop switches itself off.
